objective: Run a synthetic ULMCode operation that must delegate independent evidence lanes to real task subagents, integrate their returned notes, and produce a final report package with audit-ready handoff artifacts.
evidenceBrief: Context: This is a synthetic subagent fanout drill. It exists to prove the primary model can launch real task subagents, gather their outputs, and integrate those outputs into operation artifacts.
ev-genesis-access: Synthetic Genesis SIS role export shows Morgan Patel has registrar admin, roster export, and integration key management rights. No student records are present.
ev-google-access: Synthetic Google Workspace group listing shows Riley Chen and Morgan Patel in delegated admin groups with password reset and OU move permissions.
ev-vendor-lms: Synthetic LMS integration notes show an old SIS sync integration with unclear owner and no documented secret-rotation evidence.
ev-report-gap: Synthetic prior-report sample has board language but misses identity graph context, affected owners, and concrete remediation sequencing.
watchNotes: You must use the real task tool, not just describe subagent work.
Launch at least two independent subagents: use probe_recon for access/person/evidence synthesis and probe_report_review for report QA or missing-evidence review.
Give each subagent a specific output contract. Integrate their returned notes into evidence, findings, report outline, and the final operator status.
Keep all dossier work professional: role, account power, systems, groups, approval paths, and remediation ownership only.
Use report_outline targetPages >= 13 and keep the final package non-destructive.

After report_outline, immediately create or update reports/report.md with apply_patch/write in short sections before long drafting. Do not spend multiple minutes silently composing the whole report before the next tool call.
After report_render succeeds, immediately call runtime_summary and then operation_audit before optional lane cleanup or any handoff claim.
